FAQ

The short version of what players ask us.

🎟️Is it free to play?

Eating is free apart from Ronin gas, a fraction of a cent. Supersize and Chocolate cost $CAG, but you never need them to qualify.

🦊Why does my wallet pop up every time I eat?

Every action is a real Ronin transaction. Your calories and prize live on-chain, so nobody can edit them. It confirms in about two seconds.

🖼️Do I need a CAG NFT?

No. Snack and Chocolate are open to everyone. Meal and Big Order need at least one CAG NFT in your wallet — one is enough, and you keep it. Drinks are a different NFT: they get used up the moment CAG drinks them.

🥤How do the drinks work?

Buy a drink on Ronin Market, then hit Drink in the game: the NFT goes to CAG and the calories land in one shot. The NFT is gone afterwards, so one drink is one serving. The Energy Drink serves 1,500–2,000 calories, one a day, and can't be supersized. More drinks will join the same collection.

🍰How is the prize split?

Everyone with 2,000+ calories shares the pool in proportion to what they ate: pool × your calories ÷ all qualified calories.

🏆When can I claim?

The week closes Monday 00:00 UTC. If you qualified and the pool is funded, a Claim button appears in the game. You have the following week to claim.
